question: Does an acquired reusable abstraction improve held-out causal transfer under matched observations and resource caps?
baseline: Competitive model plus retrieval and deterministic tools, selected on development tasks
candidate: The baseline plus an acquired reusable representation and an explicit mechanism that uses it

dataset.source: Proposed synthetic causal-world generator; not implemented or frozen
dataset.holdout: 24 tasks: eight novel recombinations, eight surface/domain transfers, eight held-out causal structures

protocol.stopping_rule: Complete the frozen run matrix once; stop at a hard resource cap or safety/validity failure, retain all partial outcomes, and do not claim the incomplete matrix confirms the hypothesis.
freeze_required: equal raw acquisition evidence and acquisition-budget opportunities

notes: Planned proposal only. No generator, execution, scientific result, or permanent architecture is asserted. Paid calls require a separately authorized amended budget.
